boundaries: Current roster and portfolio listing surfaces are dense and not hop-eligible.
A current portfolio listing is not a legal ownership, current-holding, control, board-right, or exact-vehicle record.
A fellowship title does not establish direct contact with its namesake, selector identity, or a relationship with every portfolio company.
School.House faculty, cohort, sponsor, panelist, and organizer labels are distinct predicates and do not establish pairwise coordination, investment, procurement, or government endorsement.
A Form D notice identifies filer-reported offering facts but does not map a vehicle to a portfolio-company transaction.
A firm or company announcement is not an independently verified technical, operational, acceptance, or performance record.
Current-page absence is not an exact departure event, and source failure is not evidence of absence.
No private material contributes to public coverage or assertion.

interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: This package separates current listings, source-specific role claims, firm self-representations, counterparty transaction announcements, and official filings. Dense rosters create no hops. Missing records and unresolved joins remain explicit coverage states.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A reproducible public-source inventory and acquisition frontier for the declared BVVC and School.House surfaces.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A finding of wrongdoing, coordination, motive, influence, government preference, technical performance, legal control, or completeness outside the declared surfaces.

purpose: A source-addressed, graph-inert public-record lake for BVVC, School.House, current and historical roster observations, legal vehicles, financing announcements, institutional self-claims, explicit rejected joins, coverage nulls, and deterministic continuation work.

exclusion_rules: no private direct messages, screenshots, owner-supplied exports, contact details, or private-life facts
no selection based on criticism, ideology, nationality, military unit, fame, or anticipated scandal value
no conversion of marketing language into ownership, control, technical validation, government endorsement, or procurement influence
inclusion_rules: enumerate complete current leadership and portfolio page denominators before interpreting individual actors or companies
apply the same public-role and profile-resolution state to all current leadership labels
apply the same financing, legal-entity, governance-right, government-surface, and explicit-null battery to all current portfolio labels
preserve source-specific conflicts and sparse pages without reconciliation by inference
retain dense rosters as context-only and not hop-eligible
selection.selection_universe: Every visible name on the acquired current BVVC leadership page; every visible label on the acquired current Portfolio Universe page; every faculty, company, panelist, sponsor, organizer, and visible employee on the declared School.House surfaces; exact BVVC-branded SEC filers and filed related persons acquired in the bounded pass; and transaction-specific public announcements naming BVVC.
selection.symmetry_rule: An analogous defense-capital institution enters under the same complete-roster, exact-entity, transaction, governance-right, government-surface, temporal, and explicit-null rules regardless of affiliation.

source_inventory.sec_filing_caveat: The SEC has not necessarily reviewed Form D information and has not determined it accurate and complete.

storage_contract.split_reason: bounded human-reviewable shards; concatenation order is manifest-bound
